violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: dishes washed in dish machine dispensing 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Employees wash, rinsed, and sanitized all dishes that came out of dish machine.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of food throughout establishment. Observed ‘Folgers’ coffee container, mustard dressing containers used to store pickles, broth.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Please discontinue reuse of manufacturer containers and obtain additional food grade containers if necessary.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed dish machine dispensing 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please contact a technician to repair dish machine. EHS will follow up within 10 days. SARITAS RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 12/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved splitter at mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC disconnected unapproved mop splitter. EHS provided information regarding appropriate splitter.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at the dish machine observed with water temperature of 76F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC was able to restart water heater. Water temperature observed at 100F before end of inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the bar being used to store a bucket of consumable ice.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed bucket and discarded ice.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: squid, shrimp
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PIC has agreed to fully cook all seafood included in Ceviche. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days to assess compliance. SARITAS RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 06/18/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: milk (53F) in ice bath at coffee station; loroco and cheese (77F), pork and cheese (76F) at prep table in kitchen; cut lettuce (45F), pico de gallo (44-45F), curtido (51F) in 2 dr prep on cook line; horchata (46F) in drink dispenser at bar.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded horchata and all foods in 2 dr prep unit. PIC has agreed to use loroco and cheese and pork and cheese no longer than one remaining hour before discarding. PIC placed milk in ice bath to be cooled to 41F or below within the next 2.5 hours.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: fried egg, squid, shrimp, beef
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC provided disclosure for all mentioned items during inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 door prep (48F) on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC contacted repair technician during inspection. Unit is not to be used for TCS foods until repair is complete. Follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Wash water temperature observed at 76F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC provided water temperature of 110F during inspection after restarting water heater.
